name: Guided NeRF Optimization for MVS
aliases: Guided Optimization of Neural Radiance Fields for Indoor Multi-View Stereo
definition: A multi-view depth estimation method that utilizes conventional reconstruction (sparse SfM+MVS) and learning-based priors over Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). It performs test-time optimization directly over implicit volumes to eliminate the need for accurate pixel matching across views, addressing the shape-radiance ambiguity of NeRF in indoor scenes.
